svg.title: Private monitoring access
svg.desc: Prometheus, Alertmanager, and Grafana share one private service address.

g.text: Prometheus, Alertmanager, and Grafana share one private service address.
Tailnet grants control who can reach HTTPS.
Each application has its own HTTPRoute and HTTPS listener.
A dedicated monitoring service uses the shared ingress proxies.
ExternalDNS syncs three A records and ownership TXT records in Cloudflare.
cert-manager uses DNS-01 to create three ECDSA TLS Secrets.
Envoy loads the certificate for each HTTPS listener.
There is no StorageClass or persistent volume in this setup.
Pod replacement can erase metrics, silences, and Grafana database changes.
